_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: American Truck Simulator
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Drive convoys across the United States together. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated; upload the server packages you export from the game to choose the map and DLC.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./bin/linux_x64/amtrucks_server

config.files: {".local/share/American Truck Simulator/server_config.sii": {"parser": "file", "find": {" lobby_name:": " lobby_name: \"{{server.build.env.LOBBY_NAME}}\"", " password:": " password: \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_PASSWORD}}\"", " max_players:": " max_players: {{server.build.env.MAX_PLAYERS}}", " connection_dedicated_port:": " connection_dedicated_port: {{server.build.default.port}}", " query_dedicated_port:": " query_dedicated_port: {{server.build.env.QUERY_PORT}}", " server_logon_token:": " server_logon_token: \"{{server.build.env.STEAM_TOKEN}}\""}}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# American Truck Simulator. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 2239530) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. The server's settings and packages in
# .local/share are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2239530}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server reads its settings from the home folder. A config is written
# when there's none; the Panel sets the name, password, player count, ports
# and token in it at every start, and the rest is the owner's.
dir=".local/share/American Truck Simulator"
mkdir -p "$dir"
cfg="$dir/server_config.sii"
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
    cat > "$cfg" <<'EOF'
SiiNunit
{
server_config : _nameless.54e.4440 {
 lobby_name: ""
 description: ""
 welcome_message: ""
 password: ""
 max_players: 8
 max_vehicles_total: 100
 max_ai_vehicles_player: 50
 max_ai_vehicles_player_spawn: 50
 connection_virtual_port: 100
 query_virtual_port: 101
 connection_dedicated_port: 27015
 query_dedicated_port: 27016
 server_logon_token: ""
 player_damage: true
 traffic: true
 hide_in_company: false
 hide_colliding: true
 force_speed_limiter: false
 mods_optioning: false
 timezones: 0
 service_no_collision: false
 in_menu_ghosting: false
 name_tags: true
 friends_only: false
 show_server: true
 moderator_list: 0
}

}
EOF
    echo "Made server_config.sii."
fi
for key in lobby_name password max_players connection_dedicated_port query_dedicated_port server_logon_token; do
    grep -q "^ $key:" "$cfg" || sed -i "s/^server_config : .*{\$/&\n $key: \"\"/" "$cfg"
done
# The map and DLC the server offers come from server_packages.sii and .dat,
# which the game exports (export_server_packages in its console). Until the
# owner uploads their own, the base map's are used, checked against their
# SHA-256.
src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/be654a201bf3b90446569167d4864edec1b33009/truck-simulator/american-truck-simulator/ats-files"
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
for f in "server_packages.sii a4f6d740629ac196c57f1037e6f8d06d21e7a3abe7a2b0b9b5c0613756a61b50" "server_packages.dat 08ce75d97d33e23f30f5286fba094392a59fcce28e5e752d0eb46a32e2683931"; do
    set -- $f
    [ -f "$dir/$1" ] && continue
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$dir/$1.part" "$src/$1" || fail "$1 can't be downloaded right now. Reinstall to try again, or upload your own to $dir."
    [ "$(sha256sum "$dir/$1.part" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$2" ] || { rm -f "$dir/$1.part"; fail "The $1 download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv "$dir/$1.part" "$dir/$1"
    echo "Added the base map's $1."
done
echo "Installed American Truck Simulator build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Lobby name
variables.description: The name players see in the convoy browser.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be in the convoy at once.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Server token
variables.description: A Steam game server login token for app 270880, so the server keeps the same ID; empty runs without one.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
